كيف أبدأ دورتي الأولى؟: How do I start my first course?
من الصفحة الرئيسية اختر الدورة المناسبة: From the home page, choose the course that suits you and tap “Join”. The first time you join you'll be asked to complete your personal details, then you go straight to the course lessons.
هل يمكنني إعادة محاولة اختبار فشلت فيه؟: Can I retake an exam I failed?
نعم:\n• أسئلة الاستيعاب: محاولات غير محد:
Yes:
• Comprehension questions: unlimited attempts. What each lesson requires of them to complete it and unlock the next lesson is set by the lesson: passing them with the pass mark, submitting them with any score, or they are optional and don't affect completion.
• Final exam: you can retake it if you didn't pass, unless it has closed (some exams have an opening and closing date).
كيف أحصل على شهادتي بعد إتمام الدورة؟: How do I get my certificate after finishing the course?
عند إكمال جميع دروس الدورة واجتياز اختبا: When you complete all the course lessons and pass its final exam (if it has one), your certificate is issued automatically and appears under “Certificates” on the “More” screen. You can download it as a PDF at any time.
ماذا يحدث إذا خرجت من التطبيق أثناء الاخ: What happens if I leave the app during an exam?
يستمر احتساب وقت الاختبار النهائي حتى لو: The final exam timer keeps running even if you leave the app, and you can come back to finish it as long as time remains, even after the exam's closing date. Once time is up, answers are no longer accepted, and you can start a new attempt unless the exam has closed.
كيف أغيّر كلمة المرور الخاصة بي؟: How do I change my password?
من شاشة \"المزيد\" اضغط على \"بيانات الح: On the "More" screen, tap "Account details" and you'll find the "Change password" button at the bottom of the screen. Enter your current password, then your new password, and confirm it.
هل المحتوى متاح للتحميل والمطالعة دون إن: Can I download the content and read it offline?
يتطلب التطبيق اتصالاً بالإنترنت لعرض الد: The app needs an internet connection to show courses, lessons and exams. It keeps the lesson texts and audio you have opened on your device so they load faster later.
